title: Episode 1: A basic expression evaluator
summary: The first episode of a long live-coding series in which Immo Landwerth builds the Minsk compiler for a small language in C#. It starts with a basic expression evaluator and builds toward a full language.
why: Recommended as a practical, approachable build-it-step-by-step introduction to writing compilers, light on theory.

quote.text: Not too much theory but from a nuts and bolts perspective I found it extremely approachable.
